sources.use: Substantive identification/range/conservation text read. 41–47cm. Breeding male pale white/yellow iris, dark green gloss head/neck, deep orangebrown breast, chestnut and WHITE flanks, white undertail; female dark eye darkbrown head chestnut lores. Native range substantially contracted; originally NE China adjacent Russia and winter S China/N Indochina/NE Indian subcontinent. Current China breeds NE south to Yangtze floodplain and winters scattered south Yellow River; few now outside China. CR. Historic 150–700 mature figure NOT presented as current count.
Authoritative runtime scores unchanged; missing stays pending, vEst retained.

Comparison source read: 38–42cm. Steep forehead crown peak intermediate between tufted/common pochard; breeding male dark chestnut, paler flanks darker mantle/back WHITE iris, conspicuous white undertail. Female dull brown dark eye. White flight wingbar not illustrated in folded-wing portraits. Breeds E Europe to western/central Kazakhstan/western Mongolia, disjunct south/N China; China N Xinjiang/N China breeding, Yunnan/Yangtze/Taiwan winter. NT decreasing.

Comparison source read: 40–47cm. Compact, long crest breeding male, yellow iris, black/white body; female brown dull flanks deep yellow eye broad black bill tip. Native northern Palearctic Iceland/W Europe to Kamchatka, winters central Africa/Middle East/Indian subcontinent/N Indochina/S China/Korea/Japan. China NW/NE breeding Yangtze to south coast incl Hainan/Taiwan winter. LC stable.
